question: Which of the following is the scientific name of a mineral called Chromite?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron Chromium Oxide.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Chromite is a mineral composed primarily of iron(II) oxide and chromium(III) oxide compounds.
 
• It can be represented by the chemical formula of FeCr₂O₄ or Iron Chromi
